output.summary: An evergreen flowering tree native across parts of Africa, the Middle East, and western and southern Asia, athel tamarisk grows along watercourses in arid areas. Its tiny leaves exude salt that forms a crystalline crust, while nectar from its blossoms produces distinctively flavoured honey.
output.edibilityNote: Nectar from the blossoms produces high-quality honey described as having a unique taste.
